products.name: Temporal
products.blurb: Durable execution engine: workflow histories, task queues, namespaces and visibility. No foreign keys at all; rows are tied together by shard and namespace ids by convention.

products.name: Miniflux
products.blurb: Minimalist feed reader: users, feeds, entries, enclosures, API keys. The schema is rebuilt here from the migration strings in the Go source.

products.name: Listmonk
products.blurb: Newsletter and mailing-list manager: subscribers, lists, campaigns, templates, bounces.

products.name: Matrix Synapse
products.blurb: Matrix homeserver: rooms, events, devices, end-to-end keys, federation. Almost no foreign keys by design; this is the full schema at schema version 72, before later deltas.

products.name: Sourcegraph
products.blurb: Code search and intelligence: repositories, code-intel uploads, batch changes, insights, permissions. The frontend database's squashed migrations.

products.name: Cal.com
products.blurb: Scheduling: users, teams, event types, bookings, availability, apps. DDL emitted from the Prisma schema, no database needed.

products.name: GitLab CE
products.blurb: The whole DevOps platform: projects, merge requests, CI, security, packages, and much more. 1,429 tables: the stress test. Far past the explorer's comfort zone, kept in on purpose.
